# Anthony Mahler — Translation & Editing

> German–English translator and editor based in Basel, Switzerland. Translation and editing for texts in the humanities, social sciences, arts, and culture, including books, exhibition catalogues, scholarly essays, and grant applications. Working with authors, publishers, museums, and institutions internationally since 2015.

## Services

- Translation, German to English: full monographs, exhibition and collection catalogues, art theory and artists' writings, philosophy and literary theory, journal articles and edited volumes, grant applications.
- Editing of English-language manuscripts, including texts by nonnative authors and machine translations: developmental editing, line editing, copyediting, proofreading.
- Projects usually begin with a sample translation of two to three pages.

## Selected publishers and institutions

Yale University Press, Cambridge University Press, University of Chicago Press, Johns Hopkins University Press, De Gruyter, Routledge, SAGE, Bloomsbury, Brill Fink, J.B. Metzler, Felix Meiner, diaphanes, Schwabe, Hatje Cantz, Walther König, Fondation Beyeler, Josef Albers Museum Quadrat Bottrop, Fondation Vincent van Gogh Arles, University of Basel, University of Zurich.

## About

PhD in Germanic studies, University of Chicago (2014); BA, University of Pennsylvania. Postdoctoral positions in Tübingen and Zurich; research grants from the SNSF, the Mellon Foundation, and the Fulbright Program. Teaches at the Language Center of the University of Basel; based in Basel since 2012.
